conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the museum identity work coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. The research on the exhibition archive is complete, so I’m refining the type system for the identity now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a solid stage to be in. Did you get a chance to show the client the first concepts?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I presented the first concepts to the museum client last Thursday. The discussion gave me some useful direction for the next round.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. Are you folding that direction into the presentation materials already?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I am. The final presentation deck is in progress, and I’m adjusting the visual language so the custom craft and cultural references come through clearly.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I presented the first concepts last Thursday; keep the completed research, type-system work, and final deck.
